item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong direct evidence of an explicit, formal third-term attempt in 2024. I also did not find evidence that Jokowi personally refused to transfer power, delayed inauguration, or ignored the court/KPU process. The strongest negatives are therefore succession-rule manipulation and post-presidential influence-seeking, not outright refusal of term limits.","evidence":[{"title":"President Jokowi Calls on President, VP-Elect to Work Immediately after Inauguration","publisher":"Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia","date":"2024-04-24","url":"https://setkab.go.id/en/president-jokowi-calls-on-president-vp-elect-to-work-immediately-after-inauguration/","summary":"Jokowi said the Constitutional Court process was “almost complete,” said the decision must be respected as final and binding, and said the cabinet would only assist a smooth transition rather than form a separate transition team. Strong positive evidence for respecting succession rules and constitutional transfer.","question_ids":["4B.8"]},{"title":"Farewell-Welcome Ceremony for Indonesia’s President from Jokowi to Prabowo Subianto","publisher":"Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia","date":"2024-10-20","url":"https://setkab.go.id/en/farewell-welcome-ceremony-for-indonesias-president-from-jokowi-to-prabowo-subianto/","summary":"The official record shows Jokowi welcoming Prabowo at the palace after inauguration, with the transition taking place on schedule on October 20, 2024. This is direct evidence that Jokowi completed a constitutional handover rather than resisting or delaying it.","question_ids":["4B.8"]},{"title":"Indonesia court rejects election challenges, upholds Prabowo’s win","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-04-22","url":"https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-court-rejects-election-challenges-upholds-prabowos-win/2051948/","summary":"The Constitutional Court said there was no evidence of systematic fraud or presidential meddling and that state bodies had not been mobilized to sway the poll. This is late but useful corroboration that there was no confirmed third-term bid in 2024, although it does not erase the succession-manipulation concerns above.","question_ids":["4B.8"]}]}
